name: Sum of XOR Functions
title: D. Sum of XOR Functions
legend:
You are given an array a of length n consisting of non-negative integers.

You have to calculate the value of ∑
n
l=1
∑
n
r=l
f(l,r)⋅(r−l+1), where f(l,r) is al⊕al+1⊕⋯⊕ar−1⊕ar (the character ⊕ denotes bitwise XOR).

Since the answer can be very large, print it modulo 998244353.
input_spec:
The first line contains one integer n (1≤n≤3⋅105) — the length of the array a.

The second line contains n integers a1,a2,…,an (0≤ai≤109).
output_spec:
Print the one integer — the value of ∑
n
l=1
∑
n
r=l
f(l,r)⋅(r−l+1), taken modulo 998244353.
